description: Upload 10 to 20 LOCAL photo files (JPEG, PNG or WebP, under 16MB each) into the EZ Reel library, in running order, and return their assetIds for ez_reel_create. Uses a presigned upload (no storage creds). A file that fails is listed in `failed` without stopping the rest; a photo already in the library is reused (deduped) at no upload cost.

paths.description: Absolute paths to local image files, in order.

name: ez_reel_add_photos
title: Upload photos to EZ Reel
